name: times-new-roman
note: Cross-family layout through the chrome fallback table: the CSS stack 'Times New Roman', serif resolves via chrome.ts's fallback ('Times New Roman' -> Liberation Serif) at LAYOUT time — wrapping, rects and paint all use the resolved Liberation Serif face, matching Chrome's fontconfig resolution of 'Times New Roman' on this system. Proves the chrome config's fallback table is exercised by layout, not just per-string measurement.
